summary: Deployment smoke test for PHED (React + FastAPI + MongoDB) hosted at https://phed-prod-ready.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified /api/health, admin login (phedadmin/PhedAdmin@2026), auth/me, towns list containing THS, admin wards for Thanesar, admin user list, admin user create+delete, and full frontend flow: login page loads, submits credentials, redirects to /admin dashboard (metrics tiles render), navigates to /admin/employees showing Super Admin + Rahul Surveyor rows. All 8 backend tests pass; UI works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (>7000 lines with many endpoints); consider splitting admin/employee/bills routes into separate modules for maintainability.
Health endpoint response verified with db status; good practice retained.
Admin user creation requires both 'name' and 'full_name' fields per Pydantic schema — schema should be documented or unified to avoid client confusion (encountered 422 initially).
seed_data_creation: None persistent; a TEST_user_* was created and deleted in test_create_and_delete_user.

Admin create-user requires both 'name' and 'full_name'. Wards endpoint is /api/admin/wards?town_code=THS. Login UI selectors: [data-testid=login-username-input|login-password-input|login-submit-btn].
